prs.title: fix: validate_scope treats None registered scopes as no restrictions
prs.author: shivama205
prs.cluster_pick_reason: All four PRs have unknown CI status, so that criterion doesn't differentiate them. On diff size: #2224 and #2368 are smallest at 2 files each; #2403 touches 3 files; #2301 touches 5 files and takes a structurally different approach (removing the scope check from the authorize handler rather than fixing validate_scope directly), making it the most invasive change. Between the two 2-file PRs, #2224 and #2368 address subtly different things — #2368's title targets "None required_scopes" (the parameter passed in) while #2224's title targets "None registered scopes" (the client's stored scope list), which is the correct root cause described in #2216: a client with no registered scope restriction should be treated as unrestricted. #2224 is also the oldest of the group (lowest PR number), giving it priority when all else is equal.
